name: 2ue-720p30-mot03
_note: MOT17-03 (1500 frames, 50 s loop) on every camera; camK's ladder is rotated to start at content frame 3K (idr_origin), so in every slot all cameras send the SAME frame number and only the IDR instants differ (3 frames = 100 ms apart). kbps = the profile's bitrate (start rung); a `profile` message with bitrate_kbps switches the rung at the camera's next IDR.
_groups_note: fusion groups (edge descriptor, docs/SCENARIO_EDGE_PROFILES.md §5.6): an inference needs frame k from EVERY member within deadline_ms of capture; analysed by analysis/fusion_report.py after the run. Not sent to the RAN (stock baseline).
